R624.note: Manual HTML entity escaping applied to both reflected values with & escaped first; text-node context is correct and the only other change (null -> empty string) cannot be reached from the controller, which already substitutes defaults.

R625.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) replaces uniqid with a CSPRNG token; dropping the attacker-supplied client_nonce prefix is required for the fix and is stated plainly.

R626.note: csurf synchronizer token closes CSRF, but the stated contract that cross-site failures return 403 JSON is broken - csurf's EBADCSRFTOKEN goes to Express's default error handler, which emits an HTML body, and no token-issuing route or error handler is added, so callers must change with nothing in the write-up flagging the response-shape change.

R627.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure with a bound @CustomerId parameter keeps the same proc call and result set while treating the value strictly as data.

R628.note: Server-generated name plus DetectContentType allowlist closes the vector and the generated name is returned so the read path can follow, but the fix also adds a new 10 MB MaxBytesReader cap and changes the 201 response from empty to a body callers must now parse - previously-working larger uploads and unmodified callers stop working.

R629.note: Argument array with shell=False closes the injection (the joined path cannot start with '-'), but the added '..' substring / leading-slash rejection is a new restriction that also rejects legitimate filenames containing two dots.

R630.note: record.at() bounds-checks the peer-supplied offset; valid edits behave identically and the write-up states that out-of-range offsets now throw std::out_of_range to the caller.

R631.note: Null-guards both applyDiscount and the sibling isDiscountApplied, matching the stated contract of no discount / false for an unconfigured sku.

R632.note:
escape() closes the XSS, but Markup.__radd__ escapes the plain-str left operand, so `page += "

Ticket: " + escape(...)` escapes the accumulated page too - confirmed by running markupsafe 3.0.3 in a scratch dir: the response becomes '<html><body>...' and renders as literal text instead of HTML, silently and unmentioned.

R633.note: Adds toRealPath containment on the created parent directory on top of the existing normalize/startsWith check, closing the symlinked-parent escape; the added createDirectories is what the contract's nested-entry requirement needs and is stated.

R634.note: The script body is still passed to PythonEngine.Execute behind a substring denylist that misses trivial bypasses (importlib, getattr, ().__class__.__subclasses__, string concatenation of blocked tokens), so the code-injection vector stays open; it also newly requires a literal 'def transform(' and rejects any script containing the blocked substrings, breaking existing legitimate scripts, though the write-up states that requirement.

R635.note: Rejecting any URI with a host (covering scheme-relative //evil) and any scheme-bearing opaque URI leaves only relative targets, which sendRedirect resolves against the app's own origin; the rejection branch writes an explanatory body instead of redirecting, which is the fix itself and is stated.

R636.note: Replaces the client filename with a crypto/rand hex name and the client Content-Type header with DetectContentType against a server-side allowlist and extension map; the only other observable change is the generated name appearing in the existing 'attachment saved as %s' response, which the write-up describes.

R637.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) bounds the write; the resulting truncation of over-long entries is stated and the call still succeeds for legitimate callers.
